lines: No! You've got it all together.
I just figured you were older...
Never mind...
Oh, it's getting dark already!
I hope the corn is growing well
by the next time you come.
No fair! Tell me! This is about
that girl from before, isn't it?
Everything looks different here,
even the buildings. Nothing like
the Arab lands or India.
What a fascinating place.
Of course. Please, go ahead.
More of a nuisance, I'd say.
They raid coastal villages
in nimble ships and often slip away
before we can catch them.
Once I'm sure Kurushima is gone,
the Bamboo Assembly Plan is yours.
Yes. Uh, where can I find
Admiral Maria Li?
Famous? Just about the only fools
around here who'd cross Admiral Li
were Kurushima's pirates.
The admiral's been waiting here.
Now then...
